settings.git.ghAccount.name: Default GitHub account
settings.git.ghAccount.desc: The gh CLI account used by default for Issues / Pull Requests across projects. Each project can override it in its GitHub tab.
settings.git.coAuthor.name: Co-authored commits
settings.git.coAuthor.desc: Add a Co-Authored-By trailer to commits AWOG creates (session commits and task auto-commits)
settings.git.template.name: Commit message template
settings.git.template.desc: Commit subject used when AWOG auto-commits after each phase
settings.git.prReview.name: PR review prompt
settings.git.prReview.desc: Sent to the new session the “Start review” button opens from a pull-request detail. Leave empty for the built-in default.
settings.git.prReviewLlm.name: Own LLM config for review sessions
settings.git.prReviewLlm.desc: Off: the review session inherits the project's (or app's) defaults, like any new session. On: the pickers below win.
settings.git.prReviewLlm.pickDesc: Applied to the session “Start review” opens — nothing else.
settings.git.prReviewLlm.accountSessionH: The account stays whatever the session gets from the project (or app) defaults. Only the effort — and the model, if that account serves it — are applied.
settings.git.scope.name: Commit scope
settings.git.autoStash.name: Auto-stash dirty tree before task
settings.git.autoStash.desc: Stash your uncommitted changes before the engine starts a task
settings.git.dirtyPolicy.name: Dirty task policy
settings.git.dirtyPolicy.desc: When a task starts with a dirty workspace: prompt a warning, or auto-stash silently
settings.git.commitRule.name: Commit message rule (AI prompt)
settings.git.commitRule.desc: System prompt sent to the model when generating a commit message — edit to match your team's convention
